name: Haikou
source:
You are Asahi, a student who craves inspiration in a lackluster life. On the eve of his final exam he meets up with 2 friends to explore an abandoned school that is said to be the home of a horror. Maybe this experience will finally break Asahi's writers block. Only time will tell.

[From [url=https://despa-dev.itch.io/haikou]Itch.io[/url]]
